# Column filter list: clipped focus ring, olive rows in neo-dark

## Context

Operator, 2026-10-20 ~19:35Z, on the issues showcase (`examples/grid/issues`): "column filtering lists: double border does not look nice, but the styling for the dark theme.... now this is a release blocker for engine v13.3."

Measured in a browser on `dev` `cbd645db61`, with the Area menu open and "Build" selected:
- **neo-light:** the selected, navigator-active row carries `outline: 3px solid` at `outline-offset: -1px`, so 2px of the ring lie outside the row. `.neo-list` scrolls (`overflow: auto`), which clips that part at the left and right edges but not between rows. The frame comes out 1px at the sides and 3px at top and bottom: the doubled border.
- **neo-dark:** the rows paint `--list-item-background-color`, which resolves through `--cmp-list-item-surface-default` and `--sem-color-bg-neutral-highlighted` to `--gray-800` (`#292D28`, a green-tinted gray). The menu surface around them is `--grid-header-button-background-color` (`#1c1a25` in the showcase), so the list reads as an olive band.

## The Problem

The legacy `theme-light` and `theme-dark` draw a list's keyboard ring at 1px with a -1px offset, entirely inside the row. `theme-neo-light` and `theme-neo-dark` widened the ring to 3px (`--list-item-focus-outline`) but kept the -1px offset. So every list in the neo themes clips its ring the same way. The filter list shows it most, because a click puts selection and focus on the same row.

The column menu paints its own surface (`src/grid/header/plugin/Menu.scss`), but the ValuePicker inside it keeps a standalone list's row colour. The ValuePicker's only consumer is the grid header Menu.

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/scss/src/list/Base.scss`: `.neo-list-item.neo-navigator-active-item` draws `outline: var(--list-item-focus-outline)` at `outline-offset: var(--list-item-focus-outline-offset)`. `.neo-list` has `overflow: auto`.
- `resources/scss/theme-neo-{light,dark}/list/Base.scss` hold the two ring tokens.
- `resources/scss/src/grid/header/plugin/Menu.scss`: `.neo-grid-column-menu` and its `.neo-value-picker` take `--grid-header-button-background-color`.

Design authority: the legacy themes' inset ring (an offset of minus the ring width), and the operator's verdict above.

## The Fix

1. `theme-neo-light/list/Base.scss` and `theme-neo-dark/list/Base.scss`: set `--list-item-focus-outline-offset` to `-3px`, the ring's own width, so the ring is drawn inside the row. This moves every neo-theme list's keyboard ring inside its row; it moves no row and changes no colour.
2. `src/grid/header/plugin/Menu.scss`: the value picker's rows take the menu surface (`--list-item-background-color: transparent`). Hover and selection keep the theme's colours.
3. A browser e2e in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs`, red on `dev` and green at the head: in both neo themes the active selected row's ring sits inside its box, and in neo-dark a plain row paints the menu's surface.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: neo-light and neo-dark draw a list's keyboard ring inside its row: the offset equals minus the ring width.
- [ ] AC-2: the column filter list's plain rows paint the menu's surface in neo-light and neo-dark.
- [ ] AC-3 [L2, browser]: the e2e from Fix 3 fails on `dev` and passes at the head.
- [ ] AC-4 [post-merge]: the operator reads the Area filter list in both themes on the showcase and calls it clean.

## Out of Scope

- The legacy `theme-light` and `theme-dark`, whose rings are already inset.
- The menu's surface colour, which follows `--grid-header-button-background-color` (the showcase sets it).
